results.title: Mama's Boy
results.overview: A controversial affair unfolds when a young man, Glen, manipulates his stepmother, Lorraine and her sister, Leilanie, to fall for him to exact revenge on his father, Mauro. But there is twist and Glen is in for life-shattering shock.

results.title: Genderless
results.overview: Everything is political, even something as insignificant as a bathroom. The struggle to occupy spaces represents the struggle to reaffirm one's very existence. This is why we explore why the creation of gender-neutral bathrooms in the Faculty of Philosophy and Letters is so important in a country that leads in hate crimes against the LGBTQ+ community.

results.title: Hindsight
results.overview: When racial unrest plagues Chicago, Illinois, four strangers with opposing political views and cultural ideologies agree to participate in a social experiment.

results.title: Grande Maison Paris
results.overview: Famous Japanese chef Obana opens a new restaurant in Paris in the quest for his elusive third Michelin star. But Obana finds life as an outsider in Paris difficult, and even has trouble sourcing ingredients. His ambition causes tension with his team, including pâtissier Yuan, and sous chef Rinko. When his menu for a gala proves a disaster, Obana promises his former mentor that if he doesn't get three stars, he will leave Paris. Can he pull it off?

results.title: Father Hamel - A Life for the Others
Goyo
results.overview: A young autistic museum guide lives by a strict routine — until he falls in love with his coworker and must confront a whirlwind of new, intense emotions.

results.title: Unwanted Bride
results.overview: Unwanted Bride tells the story of how love, when it's with the right person, can heal even the most broken hearts. In a world where she feels out of place, one woman discovers that true love is a beautiful and transformative force.

results.title: Darlins
results.overview: When a writer cuts a creepy creature from her novel and turns down a would-be suitor, she finds her editing choices have dire consequences.

results.title: PleasureDora
results.overview: A glitchy AI love companion from the 'semi-mature' range and her lonely final customer confront mortality, second chances, and life on the scrap heap.

results.title: Pacific Fear
results.overview: A surf vacation turns into a nightmare when a group of surfers go looking for waves on a mysterious island that isn't on any map.

results.title: A Traveler's Needs
results.overview: Iris, a woman abroad in Seoul, teaches French and English in an idiosyncratic fashion that allows her to pursue her own philosophical and personal interests. Through four encounters over a single day, Iris probes students and strangers for information about poetry, their own histories, and their relationship to their egos.

results.title: Barren
results.overview: Yahya, a man with a mysterious past, sets off into the desert and wilderness with a car that serves as his home, continuing his life by cutting and selling the hair of impoverished women and girls. Until he meets a clever 15-year-old girl whose stepfather intended to sell her, but she escapes by secretly getting into Yahya's car. This encounter leads Yahya to start a new phase of trying to forget and deny his past, as everything is set to change with the presence of this girl.

results.title: Following
results.overview: A realtor who loves sneaking into people's homes finds the dead body of a scamming social media influencer – can he find out who did it?

results.title: Krzyk: Losing Control
results.overview: While driving on a highway, Lena sees a burning car and hears a scream. Compelled to find out who the deceased woman was, she slowly loses herself in the unravelling mystery. Trapped between an unresolved past and a future that’s not her own, Lena must rediscover who she is before she disappears completely.

results.title: Noite Neon
results.overview: Two stories crossed by music that meet in the same dream.

results.title: Silent Love
results.overview: A silent love story of a young man who wishes to make the dream come true of a young woman who lost her light.

results.title: 'Twas the Date Before Christmas
results.overview: To prevent her family from canceling the "Chamberlain Family Christmas Olympics," Jessie lies and says she's inviting a date to the long-standing holiday tradition. She meets Bryan on a dating app, and he agrees to spend the holiday with her and her family. As Jessie and Bryan engage in eccentric activities like the search for the Christmas tree star, gift wrapping contest and snowball fight, they start to develop real feelings for each other. Soon her family begins to catch on to their secret and Bryan suspects she may be hiding the real reason for her unusual Christmas date request. As the celebrations continue, Jessie must work to keep all her stories straight and save her date with Bryan.

results.title: Subway Shark
results.overview: A reporter goes down into the NYC subway system to investigate the phenomenon of the subway shark.

results.title: Thirty Seconds
results.overview: Artyom and Natasha are hospital clowns, they keep a blog about their volunteer experience. The girl varia has been in hospital for a long time. they are concerned about her because no matter how hard they try to help her, nothing seems to work. once artyom learns that the girl’s mother has stopped coming to see her. he realizes that only mom can help overcome the disease.

results.title: Esquinas
results.overview: An aesthetic experience that translates the intimate and poetic sound of the album Esquinas into images. With graphic and photographic elements, the visual proposal mixes the urban and the poetic, reflecting the themes of encounters and disagreements present in the songs.
